description: Off-by-one error in loop: range(len(rows) - 1) skips the last row of data
Unclosed file handle: open() is used without a 'with' statement and f.close() is never called, leaking the file descriptor
Silent type coercion: 'price' is a string from the CSV but is compared to int 0 using '>', which performs lexicographic comparison instead of numeric
Missing return statement: get_top_product() does not return best_product when best_sales > 0, so the function implicitly returns None

Index error on empty input: calculate_total_sales() does not guard against empty rows list; accessing rows[i] will work but the function silently returns 0 instead of signalling 'no data', and the off-by-one makes range(-1) which yields nothing
